name: Virtual Magic Lantern
definition: An interaction metaphor where a virtual cone, defined by a pointer device, determines a region of interest. The interior of the cone is visualized using a secondary transfer function or rendering style, while the exterior uses the original transfer function, providing simultaneous visualization of the focal region and its context.
summary: Virtual Magic Lantern is an interaction metaphor for volumetric data inspection that uses a virtual cone to render a region of interest with a secondary style while providing explicit contextual information at the boundary.
